FIX_P2.purpose: Implement code, tests, and exact unreviewed component bytes; the corpus remains ineligible until a later valid attestation.

EDIT_P2.purpose: A separate Sol reviewer reviews the exact component bytes and emits evidence; it does not edit product or provenance.

ATTEST_P2.purpose: Copy only actual review identity/evidence and exact hashes into manifest schema v2, then verify the real production corpus.

testOnlyOrLegacyHarnesses.reason: Test harness only; it is not a production corpus caller or CP1 live-admission authority.
